description: Defines the One2OneBeanRelationship class for managing one-to-one relationships in SuiteCRM, extending the base relationship class, with methods for adding relationships, updating links, and generating SQL join statements.

classes.name: One2OneBeanRelationship
classes.description: A class representing a one-to-one bean relationship in SuiteCRM, with methods to add relationships, update links, and generate join SQL statements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the relationship with a definition.
